purpose: Sensitivity screening using independent published optomechanical scales; not a calibration or physical optimum for the present device

source_reference.primary_platform: Mayor et al., Nature Communications 16, 2576 (2025), DOI 10.1038/s41467-025-57948-7
source_reference.coupling_context: Mathew, del Pino & Verhagen, Nature Nanotechnology 15, 198-202 (2020), DOI 10.1038/s41565-019-0630-8
source_reference.mapping_note: Mayor anchors kappa, gamma and g0; Mathew supplies an order-of-magnitude direct-coupling context. The present phase-dependent J_m and drive power are not measured by these sources.

normalization.reference_frequency_source: Mayor et al. 2025 measured mechanical mode
normalization.angular_rate_convention: Normalized rates are ratios to omega_m; all source SI rates are angular unless explicitly labelled Hz.

objective.constraint_scope: normalized model only; no measured hardware power, bandwidth, temperature or present-device J_m constraint
objective.selection_note: Any result is a cross-platform sensitivity result and must not be called physically optimal.

parameters.name: omega2
parameters.source_si_context: two-mode extension; not measured in Mayor device

parameters.name: hopping
parameters.source_si_context: Mathew direct-coupling context t2/2pi ~ 10 kHz, used only as a provisional proxy

parameters.source_si_context: model convention; not transferred from the experimental anchors

parameters.source_si_context: model coordinate; no SI power mapping
